name: ast-grep
description: AST-based code search and refactoring with tree-sitter parsing

tools.description: Tree-sitter powered structural code search with pattern matching
tools.usage:
ast-grep --pattern 'console.log($$$)' src/ # Find all console.log calls
ast-grep --pattern 'function $NAME($$$) { $$$ }' --rewrite 'const $NAME = ($$$) => { $$$ }' --write # Convert to arrow functions
ast-grep -l typescript --pattern 'interface $NAME { $$$ }' # Find TypeScript interfaces
ast-grep --pattern 'useState($INIT)' --rewrite 'useState<typeof $INIT>($INIT)' *.tsx # Add TypeScript generics
ast-grep --config .ast-grep.yml --fix # Apply configured rules with auto-fix
